per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The prior framework-only review and database-conflict blockers are resolved by worker-4/6 source review; remaining findings are nonblocking cautions with no open rework target.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 for doi__10.3390_ijms222312718: DBAASP Table 4 assay rows are now source-verified, sequence-normalization caveats are explicit, the supplementary PDF was boundedly checked, and final status is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.
